verdict.rationale: Treg's design matches this story: agents use one base URL and token, search the catalog by intent (`GET /catalog/search`), compare platforms, read per-endpoint parameters, and proxy calls to any of 3,800+ endpoints through `/call/`. The agent learns this small protocol from a single llms.txt fetch instead of loading thousands of tool definitions, and an MCP endpoint exposes tool-style calls such as `review(...)` and `balance`. Missing for 10: explicit docs that the MCP server exposes search/describe/call meta-tools (only review and balance are named), and independent or hands-on confirmation that context stays small in practice.
